_note: Which Claude model backs each hte.roles function (bkt-hte-self-accounting). Values are CLI model aliases, passed straight through to `claude -p --model`. `escalation` is not a role; hte.roles.extract reaches for it when its three-member ensemble disagrees above the agreement threshold in hte/roles.py's EXTRACT_AGREEMENT_THRESHOLD. `judge` runs on `opus`; `critic` stays on `sonnet` (bkt-hte-blind-roles): a judge scored by the same model family that generated and critiqued the population shares its blind spots, the documented cost on the live Younger Dryas run being a top ten by Elo of nine unbound consensus hypotheses. `hte.runner.run_campaign` logs a `judge_disagreement` count into MANIFEST.json['counts'] (how often the judge's verdict crosses the side the belief-scored opinion already favored) as a running check on this.
